now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#11
now.text: Ruby Hale, General Hale's daughter and Hydra's young enforcer, ambushes May and the team with androids at an aerospace facility.
now.on_a_card_about_b: General Hale's daughter, Hydra's young enforcer. Ambushes May's team.

proposed.text: Ruby Hale, General Hale's daughter, ambushes May and the team with androids at an aerospace facility.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: General Hale's daughter. Ambushes May's team.

changes.evidence: In All the Comforts of Home (S5#11) the masked attacker is revealed only as Hale's daughter. Hale's Hydra allegiance is first shown at the end of The Devil Complex (S5#14, 'Hail Hydra'), and Coulson first identifies Ruby as working for Hydra in Rise and Shine (S5#15). Calling her Hydra's enforcer at S5#11 gives away a later reveal.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#15
now.text: Daniel Whitehall trains R. Hale as one of his HYDRA students and chooses her for his plan to bring a future leader of HYDRA into the world. Long after his death, Hale raises her daughter Ruby for that purpose.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Whitehall's HYDRA student, chosen to bear HYDRA's future leader.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hale's HYDRA teacher, who chose her for his plan for a future leader.

proposed.text: Daniel Whitehall teaches R. Hale at Hydra's academy and chooses her to bear the child he designs to be Hydra's future leader. She agrees and raises her daughter Ruby for that purpose.

changes.evidence: Rise and Shine (S5#15): in the 1990s flashback Whitehall picks Hale to bear Hydra's future leader, and Ruby is born about 28 years before the present. So Hale raises Ruby while Whitehall is still alive, and he dies only a few years before the present (the 2016 flashback already treats him as dead). 'Long after his death' gets the timeline wrong.
